seeds.title: base-branch prints git-invalid branch names
seeds.detail: With branchFormat feature/{name}.lock or a format holding a space, .. or ~, base-branch exits 0 and prints a name git refuses. patch-slice then fails at git. state-write does not call branches.validate_format.

seeds.title: patch-slice leaves HEAD on the run branch when the milestone branch name is invalid
seeds.detail: advance_run_branch checks out the run branch before git checkout -b fails. Exit 2 is clean, but HEAD moves and origin/HEAD is set.

seeds.title: require_known_mode crashes on a config.json that holds a list
seeds.detail: AttributeError traceback, exit 1, from config.get. Not in the S-022 diff.

seeds.title: A non-string branchFormat falls back to the default silently
seeds.detail: Plan note VS-7 expected an error. load_format semantics in the spec give the default. The result is consistent with the spec.

seeds.title: branch_kind Fail path is not reachable from the CLI
seeds.detail: branch_name always raises first for a bad format, so the branch_kind conversion in the prune loop has no CLI test.
